incident.summary: A man in his 60s collapsed in a gym and is not responding.
incident.location: Mission Bay Fitness, 3rd St, San Francisco

context.nearestAed: AED — front desk, about 40 metres away

transcript.content: [incident opened: A man is lying on the floor not moving.]
I see someone on the floor. Kneel beside him, tap his shoulder hard and shout, are you okay?
Call 911 now — tap the red button. If anyone else is here, send them to the AED at the front desk, forty metres away.
Look at his chest for five seconds. Is he breathing normally?
Heel of one hand on the center of his chest, other hand on top, fingers locked. Push hard and fast with my beat.
[camera: hands look low on the abdomen]
Move your hands up — center of the chest, between the nipples. Keep going.
[helper Priya (Nurse) is on the way, ~3 min]
Turn it on and follow its voice. Bare the chest and put the pads where the pictures show.
Step back and let them take over. You did everything right.
